content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (XQL(TIM IOC Match — Outbound Session to TAXII-Fed C2 Domain) AND XQL(TIM — Periodic Beacon to Feed-Listed IOC Domain (NDR leg))) -> join on src_host (shared_entity pivot: the beacon host owned by the Causality Group Owner) within 60s. Promotes the benign-looking outbound web session to a C2 incident because the destination resolves against the subscribed mocktaxii TAXII feed.
rules.name: TIM — TAXII IOC Feed Match Stitched to Outbound NDR Session

rules.logic: BIOC(TIM — Outbound Session to TAXII-Fed IOC Domain Carrying Simulation Header) AND IOC(domain: c2-beacon.cortexsim-tim.internal) -> single incident. Confirms the simulated beacon session is both feed-matched and operator-isolable via X-Simulation-Run-ID.
rules.name: TIM — IOC Feed Match With Operator-Tagged Simulation Session
